tool_args.rationale: The damped fast-transient signature and sparse, correlated pilot rows leave the underlying dynamics insufficiently identified. A fine trajectory batch can resolve the transient and distinguish candidate mechanisms before confirmation at the target horizon.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a stationary smooth model to the pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five rows have correlated inputs and only long horizons, so they do not distinguish fast transient dynamics from competing slow mechanisms.
The nuisance measurement is not relevant to identifying the temporal law.
